answer: Price fake identities off a terrace: standing rises one terrace step at a time, and each step demands a fresh endorsement from a peer outside the applicant's funding cluster plus a deposit locked in basalt custody for a full epoch. A kernel record chains every endorsement by hash, so a forged step breaks the chain in public. Copies sharing one funder share one step: they pay N deposits yet gain a single step, and one proven forgery forfeits every deposit on that step at once.
